translations.web: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
translations.bsb: Suddenly a leper came and knelt before Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”
translations.kjv: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
translations.asv: And behold, there came to him a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
